# Bhoomit Ganatra

> Personal portfolio and resume of Bhoomit Ganatra, a Senior Full-Stack (MERN) Engineer at Cornerstone OnDemand (Pune, India). He has worked in production software engineering since December 2020, mostly on Node.js/TypeScript backends, real-time systems, cloud migrations and AI/RAG features.

This site is a single-page React app. Its full content is summarised below, so you don't need to run JavaScript to read it. Blog posts are loaded at runtime from the dev.to API.

## Profile

- Name: Bhoomit Ganatra (GitHub handle: bhumit070)
- Role: Senior Full-Stack (MERN) Engineer at Cornerstone OnDemand, building MyGuide.org
- Location: Pune, India (hybrid)
- Professional experience since: December 2020
- Open to freelance work through Upwork

## Highlights

- Built an AI chatbot on a RAG pipeline with OpenSearch vector search, which raised product usage by 20%
- Led a platform migration from Azure to AWS and a legacy PHP to Node.js migration
- Cut CI build time by 50%, memory footprint by 30%, and latency on real-time Socket.IO/Redis infrastructure by 25%
- Hands-on with distributed systems (Redis, RabbitMQ, OpenSearch) and automated testing (Vitest, PHPUnit)

## Work History

### Software Engineer, Cornerstone OnDemand (11/2023 to present, Pune, hybrid)

Building MyGuide.org (https://myguide.org).

- Designed and shipped an AI chatbot using a RAG pipeline with OpenSearch vector search, increasing product usage by 20%
- Led the migration of the whole platform from Azure to AWS to get larger committed-use discounts. Spotted that a CloudFront/S3 wildcard folder-access policy could replace a proposed Lambda-based signature check, which avoided extra compute cost
- Led the migration of a legacy PHP codebase to Node.js across core services, backed by automated tests in PHPUnit and Vitest, with no disruption to existing users
- Re-architected Docker builds into a multistage pipeline in GitHub Actions, cutting CI build time by 50%
- Diagnosed and fixed long-standing Redis and cURL issues in legacy services, reducing memory usage by 30%

### MERN Developer, Yudiz Solution (02/2022 to 11/2023, Ahmedabad, onsite)

- Took full ownership of the company's video-calling platform (architecture, roadmap and maintenance) and led a refactor of its core modules that cut latency by 25%
- Built scalable game APIs and real-time systems with Socket.IO and Redis Pub/Sub, improving performance and reliability by 30%
- Mentored 3 junior developers on the MERN stack and contributed to internal onboarding and training

### JavaScript Developer, Freelance (12/2020 to 02/2022, remote)

- Built Node.js APIs powering several client web applications
- Developed React and Vue applications, introducing TypeScript, GraphQL and PWAs
- Re-architected a frontend-heavy client app from fetching whole datasets on every request to targeted, field-scoped API calls, cutting initial load time from about 5 minutes to 10-12 seconds (about 95% faster)
